jobs.occupation: Postdoc - Innovative Biopredictive Dissolution (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionHow can experimental dissolution science and digital approaches help us better understand the performance of tomorrow's oral medicines? We are seeking a curious and motivated Postdoc to join our Biopharmaceutics and Dissolution Sciences team in Biberach. You will lead a research project focused on advancing biopredictive dissolution approaches for challenging compounds and advanced oral formulations.Combining hands-on laboratory research, mechanistic interpretation and modern digital tools, you will explore how drug substance properties, formulation attributes and experimental conditions influence in vitro performance and support oral formulation development.Working with multidisciplinary experts and state-of-the-art technologies, you will build your independent research profile and gain experience in pharmaceutical development, with opportunities for peer-reviewed publications and international scientific exchange.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is limited for 2 years.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.Note: To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.Tasks & responsibilities- You independently design, conduct and evaluate studies to develop physiologically relevant, biopredictive dissolution approaches for challenging compounds and advanced oral formulations.- By investigating dissolution, supersaturation and precipitation, you derive mechanistic insights into how drug substance properties, formulation attributes, manufacturing variables and test conditions influence in vitro performance.- Building on these insights, you apply the developed approaches to drug development questions and critically assess their applicability and limitations.- Your findings enable you to develop practical recommendations and best practices for oral drug product development.- Using digital, data-driven and computational tools, you analyze complex datasets and support evidence-based decisions.- As part of a multidisciplinary environment, you collaborate with experts in formulation development, biopharmaceutics, pharmacokinetics, modeling and regulatory sciences.- Through scientific reports, peer-reviewed publications and presentations, you communicate your research findings to internal teams and at international conferences.Requirements- PhD in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Food Science or a related discipline.- Hands-on experience in dissolution testing, oral formulation development, biopharmaceutics or a related experimental field. Experience with poorly soluble compounds, amorphous solid dispersions, supersaturation or precipitation is advantageous.- Experience in analytical method development using techniques such as HPLC/UPLC, UV spectroscopy or comparable methods. Experience with solid-state or particle characterization, imaging or laboratory automation is advantageous.- Sound understanding of oral drug absorption and its relationship to drug substance properties, formulation performance and gastrointestinal conditions. Knowledge of physiologically relevant dissolution testing, IVIVR/IVIVC, PBBM/PBPK modeling or regulatory biopharmaceutics is advantageous.- Ability to independently plan and conduct experiments, critically analyze complex datasets and draw clear scientific conclusions. Interest or experience in computational tools, scientific informatics, knowledge management or AI-enabled knowledge discovery is desirable. Experience with statistical data analysis is advantageous.- Scientific curiosity, a proactive and well-organized working style, and the ability to collaborate across disciplines and functions. Excellent scientific communication, presentation and technical writing skills in English. German language skills are advantageous but not required.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What We OfferWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 11, 2026. jobs.description: At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleThe Enterprise UX practice at HelloFresh is a cross-functional team that brings physical and digital product and service experiences to life through strategic research, service design, prototyping, and storytelling. We are dedicated to transforming enterprise ways of working by applying structured methods like Definition Sprints, Service Blueprinting, and AS-IS and TO-BE mapping, creating meaningful & effective enterprise experiences to shape the future of HelloFresh’s Supply Chain.As a Senior Service Designer, you will leverage your research and service design expertise to shape compelling visions for both product and process improvements. You will deeply investigate current ways of working—identifying key data archetypes, mapping AS-IS states, and collaboratively defining desired TO-BE workflows. Your insights will identify the most impactful opportunities for investment. You will closely collaborate with product, engineering, users and operational stakeholders to design, prototype, and validate scalable solutions aligned with our Enterprise Design System.About the DomainThe wider Food Systems Alliance owns technology that enables a lean and sustainable procurement process from Suppliers to HelloFresh facilities and improves customer experience with accurate ingredient data flow and optimal ingredient quality. Optimising cost of ingredients, providing customers with the freshest and best ingredients, and enabling buying decisions that reduce excess stock and other forms of inventory waste are just some of the focus areas for this alliance.What you’ll do- Conduct and lead strategic Definition Sprints to uncover user needs, validate hypotheses, and collaboratively define clear next steps for design and development.- Map current (AS-IS) enterprise processes and systems, identifying pain points and opportunities, then collaboratively design optimized (TO-BE) processes, particularly within the Food Systems alliance  - the cluster that takes care of supply chain management topics within Hello Fresh..- Partner and inspire other enterprise designers to excel in service design and prototyping, nurturing growth within the team.- Deeply understand the user journeys and workflows of Recipe Developers, Menu Planners, and Buyers, building strong stakeholder relationships to advocate effectively for these users.- Develop and align design concepts and prototypes with the Enterprise Design System to ensure scalability and consistency across enterprise tooling.- Form collaborative partnerships with POs, engineers, and researchers, using influence to elevate UX solutions and challenge broader assumptions within internal product teams.- Mentor and coach designers in creating user experiences demonstrating pride in craft, clarity, and effectiveness.- Create UX/UI flows and experiences that elegantly address complex enterprise problems with delightful, user-centric solutions.- Facilitate clear communication across teams, leveraging structured storytelling methods to amplify your impact.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll bring- 4+ years of product design experience, particularly within enterprise or B2B contexts.- Proven track record in applying structured service design methodologies such as Definition Sprints, AS-IS/TO-BE mapping, and Service Blueprinting.- Additional experience leading projects, mentoring, or directly managing design team members.- A portfolio demonstrating impactful, user-centered enterprise experiences and a high level of craft.- Expertise in visual design, interaction design, UX writing, and UI design.- Mastery of Figma and familiarity with relevant prototyping and service design tools.- Excellent communication skills in English, capable of articulating complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.What we offerElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: User Experience Design
